title: Eternals
tagline: Seven thousand years. Still time for dinner.
about: Immortal beings who have lived on Earth for thousands of years reunite to stop an ancient threat.

Serve the snacks when the Eternals track down Kingo on his film set.

Officers and crew dine together. Prices subject to change, paid in ship's credit. Laser issue, fleet standard. Form G-7000, sheet 2 of 2. 2021. Crew notes: Kingo the movie star. Phastos building gadgets. Thena and her sword.
